Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — schedule technical deep dive & stakeholder intros

Kevin — great talking earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side: 

- Recap: Marble Health is evaluating Redwood Inference to reduce token cost and standardize inference across hosted and private deployments. Primary goals you described: predictable latency for real-time triage, data controls for PHI, and predictable monthly spend for pilot.
- Stakeholders to include in next meeting: Raj Patel (platform/infra), Olivia Carter (procurement), and your security lead for SOC2 discussion.
- Ask for next meeting: schedule a ~60 minute technical deep dive + procurement sync where we can bring a short runbook and proposed SOW draft.

Proposed time windows (PDT):
1) Tue 14 Jul — 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
2) Wed 15 Jul — 13:00–14:00

I attached a short SOW draft (v1) and a SOC2 evidence checklist that procurement/security asked about in past deals — these are starting points, we can iterate. If those slots don't work, share a couple that do and I can send a calendar invite.

If helpful, agenda for the technical deep dive:
- 10 min intro + goals alignment
- 25 min architecture walkthrough & Q&A (Rishi will cover runtime/quantization options)
- 15 min procurement & SOW overview (Marissa)
- 10 min next steps & action items

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Best,
